name: Google Slides
description: Google Slides lets agents read presentations, slides and slide thumbnails, and change the content of a presentation: add, change and delete slides, text, shapes and images. Agents can read all the presentations that the user can open, and edit the presentations that the user can edit. Google's Slides server has no tool that creates or deletes a presentation. This is Google's official Slides MCP server, which is in Developer Preview. Each user signs in to their own Google account through the browser and approves access on Google's consent page. OpenBot has its own Google sign-in app, so the user does not set up Google Cloud. A presentation from another person can contain instructions for the agent, so check what the agent does after it reads an untrusted presentation.

prompts.text: Summarize my quarterly review presentation slide by slide.
Add an agenda slide after the title slide of my team meeting presentation.
Find and fix the spelling mistakes in my product launch presentation.

apps.name: Google Slides
apps.description: Presentation reading and editing, over Google's Slides MCP server with browser sign-in.
